# Core Capabilities

ADVISOR supports research and applied transportation projects through integrated sensing, analytics, and visualization capabilities.

:::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### High-Resolution Multimodal Mobility Data
Collection and analysis of pedestrian, cyclist, vehicle, transit, and curbside activity.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Real-Time Detection and Post-Processed Analytics
Computer vision workflows for object detection, tracking, classification, and event extraction.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Curbside Behavior and Obstruction Analysis
Measurement of dwell time, double parking, occupancy, compliance, and access conflicts.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Intersection and Crossing Insights
Evaluation of pedestrian activity, crossings, conflicts, and near-miss patterns.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Operational Traffic and Access Patterns
Analysis of circulation, lane use, origin-destination patterns, and peak demand.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Non-Motorized Mobility and Stress Detection
Use of wearable sensors to understand pedestrian and cyclist stress in real environments.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card-box}
### Environmental and Behavioral Data Integration
Fusion of air quality, weather, physiological, and mobility data for richer decision-making.
:::
::::
